*   **The Narrative:** "Our revenue isn't just growing; it's highly sustainable. A Net Revenue Retention of [X]% demonstrates that our clients are not only staying with us but expanding their engagements, proving strong product-market fit and customer loyalty."

If you can provide the specific growth percentages and retention rates, I would be happy to help you draft the complete, polished narrative or format it into an email or presentation slide!
